referenceFunction.generalComment: Inventory refers to the entire transport life cycle. For rail infrastructure, expenditures and environmental interventions due to construction, renewal and disposal of railway tracks have been allocated based on the Gross tonne kilometre performance of freight transport on SBB railway tracks in 2014 ( 20260 Mio. Gtkm). Expenditures due to operation of the rail infrastructure, as well as land use have been allocated based on the yearly train kilometre performance (8615 Mio tkm). Diesel consumption for traction have been updated based on SBB data for the year 2019. For the diesel consumption for traction no data was avaiable from Switzerland as no diesel freight train are used anymore. Therefore a similar consumption to Austria was assumed due to topographical reasons (10.3g/tkm).; UUID: 66f5b1f6-22d2-3230-96ca-411aa1d5b6c4
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventory includes the energy consumption of a goods train in Switzerland using diesel energy and a particle filter. In addition also the diesel consumption and emissions of shunting processes, the production and maintenance of vehicles as well as the construction and maintenance of the rail way tracks are accounted for.
